name: V ZONE
source: The protagonist bought 5 highly priced special adult VHS and found he could enter the VHS world acting as the main character of each VHS himself. During the exploration of the VHS world the protagonist realizes that all the characters are linked, so he must find clues related to each title and push the story of each title to the very end.
translation: 主角高价购买了5张特殊的成人VHS，并发现他可以作为每张VHS的主角进入VHS世界。在探索VHS世界的过程中，主角意识到所有的角色都是相互联系的，所以他必须找到与每个标题相关的线索，并将每个标题的故事推向最后。
